acceptance: `forge new` with the TSX template produces the client app, which pushes clean and serves; forge-portal-e2e's suite exercises navigation, live update and a pending form and passes on CI (run id in evidence).
The step's report restates SPA-1's ranking for SPA-10..SPA-13 and the order this roadmap runs them in.
author: rory

gaps.description: notes are readable only by the user who wrote them (select policy created_by eq $user_id), not by every viewer
gaps.note: a table with no select policy is default-deny (forge-storage rls.rs rls_enforcement), so some policy is required; owner-reads is the simplest one true as written, the README says so, and the e2e's two sessions are the same user, which is what a live list across a user's tabs means

gaps.description: a schema.lock compile failure at forge new is still a printed warning, not a scaffold error
gaps.note: the brief asked to verify, not change it; every_dialect_scaffold now asserts the lock is written and holds notes, so a template that stops compiling fails the test

gaps.description: serving is not proven by forge-cli's tests
gaps.note: by design: forge check (the push's checker) admits all four dialects in-process; serving is proven by forge-portal-e2e spa-beta.spec.ts in portal-e2e run 39252809740 (forge_cli_ref=step-spa9)

gaps.description: portal-e2e run 39252809740 (step-spa9, forge_cli_ref=step-spa9): spa-beta passed (ws-668470acaa7bdae0 converged, routed /wave -> /notes, pending then listed, B repainted live) but client-page and spa-live failed because their fixtures re-declared the notes table, list_notes and add_note the scaffold now ships (forge check: two NoteRow shapes; spa-live never converged, 404). forge-portal-e2e 8ce4d09 drops the fixtures' domain halves so each brings only its page; forge check on the lane binary admits scaffold+client-page (11/11), scaffold+spa-live (11/11) and the bare scaffold (10/10); re-run dispatched as 39260691024
the forge-lang verify ladder (exit 0, all four rungs) is not recorded green because the forge-portal-e2e lane is not a harness consumer
gaps.note: forge-lang is unchanged by this step; the ladder's pass stands as run and re-running it would meet the same unreadable lane

statement: The beta line: a client app with routing, a live list and pending forms ships through forge new and the portal end to end — Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 are what make client TSX credible before the beta waitlist (Rory, 2026-10-17); rows 4, 6, 7 and 8 follow during the beta. forge new's TSX starter gains a client app: layout, two routed pages, a live list and a form with pending state. forge-portal-e2e proves it pushed and served on the dev stack.
